notes: Night action off Lunga Point, 4–5 September 1942, in which high-speed transports Gregory (APD-3) and Little (APD-4) were sunk. JACAR 8th Fleet September 經過 (C08030022600, PDF p. 14, 攻撃実施 table) records 有明、夕立、初雪、叢雲 engaging 1 CA and 1 DD at 2200 in the 4 September landing sequence (wartime claim that both were sunk).
